question: Are all models free to use?
answer: All models on [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com) are free to prototype with. Once you hit rate limits, see the Deploy section to use partner endpoints or deploy a NIM locally.

question: How many requests can I make?
answer: The free tier runs on rate limits - up to 40 requests per minute (RPM) for most models, with no per-token billing. Your personal rate limit is shown in the top-right of the dashboard.

question: Why are the API endpoints free?
answer: We believe open model inference offers the best cost-performance for most workloads. The free tier exists so you can verify that yourself before committing to anything.

question: How do I choose the right model?
answer: Each model page lists benchmarks, supported tasks, and context window. When in doubt, use the playground to test before you integrate.

question: How do I deploy to my own infrastructure?
answer: Download a NIM container and run it on your own cloud, via a CSP partner (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), or on a Brev GPU instance. The API is identical - no code changes required.

question: What is NemoClaw?
answer: NemoClaw is a sandboxed runtime for autonomous agents. Network requests, file access, and inference calls are all policy-gated. Nothing is permitted by default.
